title: Binance Has Completed the Conversion of Selected Token Balances to USDC (2025-04-30)
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians,   Binance has completed the conversion of the following token balances to USDC. The conversion of the following tokens were executed between  2024-10-29 00:00 (UTC) and 2025-04-28 23:59 (UTC).    Conversion of Tokens: 0.981 USDC/VAI 8.511 USDC/TORN 0.385 USDC/OMG 1.51 USDC/WAVES 0.0181 USDC/XEM 1.0025 USDC/BOND 0.0028 USDC/DOCK 0.00219 USDC/MDX 0.285 USDC/POLS 0.000072 USDC/PURSE Please Note: The conversion of the above token balances to USDC is based on users’ token holdings in their Binance accounts at the snapshot time of  2024-10-29 00:00 (UTC) . Users who held  less than 0.01 USDC  worth of token (based on average token exchange rate)   are  not  eligible for the conversion. Users may confirm the receipt of USDC tokens via Assets > Transaction History >  Distribution . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.   For More Information: Notice on the Withdrawals of Delisted Tokens & Conversion of Selected Tokens to USDC (2024-10-08) Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-30 	 USDC is an e-money token issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS ( https://www.circle.com/ ). USDC’s whitepaper is available  here . You may contact Circle using the following contact information: +33(1)59000130 and  EEA-Customer-Support@circle.com .  Holders of USDC have a legal claim against Circle SAS as the EU issuer of USDC. These holders are entitled to request redemption of their USDC from Circle SAS. Such redemption will be made at any time and at par value.
